settings_item_desc: Require biometrics or your device password to open the app
settings_intro: App Lock asks for biometric confirmation - or your device password if biometrics aren't set up - each time you open re/task and after it has been in the background for a while. Your tasks stay encrypted on this device either way - this is a quick-access guard, not extra encryption.
unavailable_desc: Add a fingerprint or face unlock in your device settings to use App Lock.
enable_desc: Require {biometry} or your device password to open the app.
enable_desc_device_credential: Require your device password to open the app.
timeout_desc: How long the app can stay in the background before asking again.
enable_failed: Couldn't enable App Lock. Please try again.
locked_desc_device_credential: Unlock with your device password to continue.

error.lockout: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, or use your password.
error.unavailable: Biometrics aren't available right now. Use your password.
error.vault: Couldn't unlock on this device. Use your password to continue.
